caveats: No civil lawsuit was actually filed: Erica Reynolds filed a $12.5M notice of claim (June 2019) over a warrantless Dec 26, 2018 body-cavity search by Officer Timaree Murphy, and the city council approved a $1.6M settlement (Dec 2019, reported as 'up to $1.6 million'; sources give the approval date as Dec 17 or Dec 19) before any suit was filed — hence year_filed null; 'civilian' is the closest lawsuit_type fit. No criminal charges against any officer; Murphy received a 40-hour suspension and a matching AZPOST certification suspension.
